memory_method: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo OS peak working set and peak commit; sampled every 20 ms; probe separate from server/driver
correctness_scope: real repository-file MCP transport, not native Codex/cloud correctness

baseline.method: Nearest lower order statistic. Compare matching baseline/proxy runs; subtract quantiles, not paired per-request latency. Barrier wait is included identically in both runs.

proxied.method: Nearest lower order statistic. Compare matching baseline/proxy runs; subtract quantiles, not paired per-request latency. Barrier wait is included identically in both runs.
